lines.1: 「Hmm. It galls me to be judged by Tsushima, but I suppose an ordinary person's opinion is exactly what we need.」
lines.4: 「Which one of us is the most mature.」
lines.6: 「Who is? I'll boil you alive, Crab.」
lines.7: I fixed the deluded fool with a murderous glare.
lines.8: 「Aw, don't get shy on me, you pure-hearted boy of the Heisei era.」
lines.10: 「(It just looks like her eyes are closed.)」
lines.12: 「Anyway, Miss Inori is the sexiest by a mile. That's the one point I will never concede.」
lines.14: 「You're way too old to count, Inori!」
lines.15: 「I am not that old. I am only twenty-three.」
lines.16: 「Peck! Peck! Making me angry was your mistake!」
lines.17: 「Ow, ow! What the hell, you rotten parakeet? Stop pecking me!」
lines.18: 「I am a parrot, you fool. They are completely different.」
lines.19: 「What is the difference between a parrot and a parakeet?」
lines.20: 「I am afraid I do not know either.」
lines.21: 「Anyone who insults Inori gets a taste of my hellish beak--Hell's Bill. One peck, and you'll see stars in broad daylight.」
lines.22: 「That name means the same thing twice!」
lines.23: 「Uh, what were we talking about again?」
lines.25: 「We're deciding who is the most mature. Tsushima, you judge us. We'll imagine a situation, then each say the most grown-up line we can.」
lines.26: 「Tell us whose line shakes you the most.」
lines.27: 「Huh. I never thought the Princess would play a game like that.」
lines.28: 「It sounds fun to see everyone's personality come out. Besides, I'm going to win anyway.」
lines.29: 「We'll see about that. So, Inori, what's the scenario?」
lines.30: 「It is Valentine's Day. Give chocolate to a boy you secretly love, with the intention of winning his heart.」
lines.31: 「What? That's not scandalous or grown-up at all. As a parrot, I'm disappointed. It doesn't ruffle my feathers.」
lines.36: 「Besides, that isn't the sort of thing you perform for an audience.」
lines.38: 「True. It is not something one performs for an audience. I will not participate either.」
lines.39: 「You're a third-year, one above us, Otome-senpai. Considering how humiliating it would be if you lost, you probably should sit this one out.」
lines.40: 「Hmph. Very well. I shall rise to your provocation.」
lines.41: 「Now it's getting interesting. Who wants to go first?」
lines.42: 「They don't call me the vanguard for nothing! I'm first!」
lines.45: Fine. I might as well play along.
lines.47: 「Yeah. The truth is... I've really liked you for a long time. You might not have noticed, 'cause you're incredibly dense.」
lines.51: 「N-No good. Hearing lines like that from Crab is just ridiculous.」
lines.52: 「What the hell? I'm putting my heart into this!」
lines.57: Poor girl. She clearly didn't want to do this.
lines.61: 「If you'd like... my house is close by, so would you come eat it with me?」
lines.64: That was close. She'd just made my heart skip a huge beat.
lines.65: 「I suppose I'm next. Tsushima, don't get carried away, mistake this for the truth, and pounce on me.」
lines.73: 「I've had my eye on you for some time. Become mine.」
lines.74: 「The dreams you'll share with me are sweeter than that chocolate.」
lines.75: 「Hey, Inori. What do you make of that line? As a parrot, I find it questionable.」
lines.76: 「Delivered that coldly, it leaves me rather cold.」
lines.78: 「But it scored a critical hit on the boy. Look at him swoon.」
lines.81: 「So I am last... To be honest, I have no experience with this, so I do not really understand it.」
lines.82: 「Don't you give chocolate to people in your club?」
lines.83: 「Ah, the martial arts club chocolate. I throw one piece among the men, and whoever wins the ensuing fistfight gets to eat it.」
lines.85: The weaker men never even got to taste their beautiful upperclassman's chocolate.
lines.86: 「No matter. I shall begin. I will handle this like a maiden.」
lines.87: 「Maidens don't strike a battle pose every time they do something.」
lines.90: 「Mm... I cannot say anything clever, so I shall show you through my actions.」
lines.91: She wrapped an arm around my waist.
lines.95: The answer slipped out before I could stop it.
lines.96: How could it not, when she stared at me with those proud, blade-sharp eyes?
lines.97: 「Hmm. That confession had very little to do with chocolate.」
lines.98: 「As expected, you slay the ladies. I think I'd let you hold me too, Otome-senpai.」
lines.99: 「I believe Kanisawa's was the purest, while Sato's was the greediest.」
lines.101: 「Mr. Tsuchinaga, would you peck her for me?」
lines.102: 「Hah! You shameless girl from the village of Eros!」
lines.104: 「Stop that! I'm the only one allowed to bully Yoppi! I'm the only one allowed to make her cry! I'm the only one allowed to hold her! In short, Yoppi belongs to me!」
lines.105: 「I show no mercy, not even to the student council president! I have one finishing move: pecking and stabbing! In other words, I actually have two! And gouging!」
lines.107: Right. Of the Thirty-Six Stratagems, fleeing was best.
lines.110: 「Hey there! Shin the Rampaging Rogue has arrived!」
lines.112: 「When all's said and done, it's gotta be me.」
lines.113: 「My condolences, everyone. We all know I'm going to win.」
lines.116: 「Hey! Since when do you get to be surrounded by girls? Traitor! Did you forget our promise that we'd become adults together?」
lines.117: 「That's not what this is, so calm down. And I never made a horrible promise like that.」
lines.118: 「...Send one of them my way--anyone except Crab. Yoppi would be my first choice.」
lines.119: 「Your whole way of thinking is pathetic.」
lines.120: 「Fukahire, you're in the way. Vanish within three seconds.」
lines.121: 「If only I were an invincible hero... I'd punish you for treating people like they don't matter...」
lines.124: Who was the most mature... or rather, whose confession moved me the most?
